messages:
Ollie (Finance): Received invoice from SakuraData (JP-021). They marked 'consumption tax exempt' and added a note: 'Please gross-up 10% withholding per Japanese tax guidance.' Amount USD 21,000. Anyone seen this pattern?
Priya (Accounts Payable): Do we have their Japanese business registration or residency docs? W-8/W-9 not relevant here.
Satoshi (Vendor Ops): Vendor emailed that services were provided remotely from Tokyo. No attachments except the invoice. They say clients should gross-up for "source withholding"  vague.
Hana (Legal): Need evidence before changing payment amount. Request: (1) Japanese Corporate Number or Certificate of Tax Payment; (2) copy of the tax counsel memo or statute they rely on; (3) reissued invoice showing tax lines or explanation if zero-rated. If they expect gross-up, require contract amendment.
TaxBot: Auto-scan: JP corporate number pattern looks like: 12-digit number. No data attached to verify. Japan generally has withholding on certain payments to non-residents (royalties, some service fees) but specifics matter. Recommend vendor provide Certificate of Tax Status or proof of remittance.
Ollie (Finance): Agreed. Priya please hold payment. Satoshi, can you ask them for the docs and a worked example of the gross-up?
Priya (Accounts Payable): Blocking payment in AP system now. I'll add a tax hold reason: "awaiting vendor tax docs (JP)".
Satoshi (Vendor Ops): Drafting message to vendor: 
```
Hi SakuraData,
Thanks for the invoice. To proceed we need:
1) Japanese Corporate Number (or copy of registration) and a Certificate of Tax Payment / Tax Residency;
2) A reissued invoice that either breaks out consumption tax or explicitly states why it is exempt/zero-rated;
3) If you require Redwood to gross-up, please provide the legal basis (statute or counsel memo) and a sample gross-up calculation showing the exact amount you expect us to pay.
Please provide within 72 hours so we can process payment.
Thanks,
Satoshi
```
Hana (Legal): If they supply a statute or official guidance, we'll review. But we will not unilaterally increase payments without a signed amendment. If it's material, Finance will model the cash impact and we may negotiate a net/gross position.
Ollie (Finance): Noted. I'll prepare a quick gross-up calc template in case they push. Hana, if vendor sends remittance proof we can accept that as post-payment substantiation?
Hana (Legal): Acceptable if it's tied to this invoice period and includes official payment confirmation from Japanese tax authority or an accountant's certificate.
TaxBot: Reminder: if work was performed outside Japan, withholding may not apply. Ask vendor to state location of performance on the invoice (city/country) to help determine tax treaty/status.
Priya (Accounts Payable): OK blocking payment. Satoshi please update when vendor replies. :white_check_mark:
